section.content: 本发明公开了一种人工智能转人工智能的方法，该方法通过建立呼入系统，实现客户呼叫接入，同时在呼叫中心建立基本的功能设施，包括但不仅限于IVR自动语音导航、自动呼叫分配、自动报工号、电话排队管理、来电弹屏、通话录音、业务受理、多方电话会议、知识资料库管理和满意度调查。通过以上步骤设置然后经过测试，最终实现人工智能转入人工智能时，不需要经过非智能化操作，很大程度上减少了人工客服的投入，节约成本，同时也能够提高客户进行服务咨询时的信息反馈速度。

The invention discloses a method for converting artificial intelligence into artificial intelligence, which realizes customer call access by establishing a call-in system, and simultaneously establishes basic functional facilities in a call center, including but not limited to IVR automatic voice navigation, automatic call distribution, automatic work number reporting, telephone queuing management, incoming call screen flipping, call recording, service acceptance, multi-party telephone conference, knowledge database management and satisfaction survey. Through the steps, the artificial intelligence is finally switched into the artificial intelligence through testing, non-intelligent operation is not needed, the investment of artificial customer service is reduced to a great extent, the cost is saved, and meanwhile, the information feedback speed of a client in service consultation can be improved.

Method for converting artificial intelligence into artificial intelligenceTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and digital signal interaction, in particular to a method for converting artificial intelligence into artificial intelligence.

Background

The artificial intelligence realizes that audio signal input is converted into digital analog signals on the basis of internet communication, corresponding data are identified through the artificial intelligence and then answered, common solutions are provided through the artificial intelligence, and the uncounted unusual problems are converted into artificial services to be answered, so that investment in the aspect of artificial customer service is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the feedback efficiency of customers is improved.

However, in the process of digital exchange, when artificial intelligence is converted into artificial intelligence, automatic identification and selection are required for a client, artificial intelligence interaction has non-intelligent connection, and when manual operation fails, conversation interaction before selection needs to be performed again, so that inconvenience is caused, consultation processing efficiency of the user is reduced, and satisfaction of the client is reduced.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a method for converting artificial intelligence into artificial intelligence, which aims to solve the problems in the background art.

In order to achieve the purpose, the invention provides the following technical scheme: a method for converting artificial intelligence into artificial intelligence comprises the following specific operation procedures:

the method comprises the following steps: and (3) calling system deployment:

the incoming call type call center mainly answers the incoming call of a service object, provides a series of services and supports for the service object, and aims at the business characteristics and processes of an enterprise service department or other service organizations which need to process a large number of incoming calls, provides a set of customer service management system which integrates the front-end call center and the back-end customer service management system seamlessly, integrates the functions of automatically popping up the basic information of a customer and the prior business project record, complaint record, automatic call recording, query function, statistical analysis function, report generation, knowledge base management and the like in a business system taking customer service as the center, integrates different communication channels such as telephone, short message, E-Mail and the like, realizes the integrated integration of processing by a platform and an interface, has good openness and strong integrated integration capability, and can conveniently realize the perfect combination with the original business system and the user database system in the enterprise, two servers are separated, 1 account is respectively created, and 3 cards are needed after 1 time, which is exemplified as follows: the method comprises the steps that 1 account is established in local 192.168.1.8 and 192.168.1.26 servers respectively, and a normal incoming call account is opened.

Step two: setting basic functions of the call center:

and the complete call system establishment is completed by setting the basic functions of the call center.

Step three: and (3) testing:

after the configuration is completed, the mobile phone dials an incoming number of a first robot, namely a number of a corresponding card on a gateway, then the calling number is converted into a manual number or the calling number is converted into the manual number without being identified twice, the calling number is directly converted into an account number corresponding to a second server, conversation with the corresponding robot can be realized, the acceptance criteria of gateway telephone and IP butt joint are basically the same, the specific operation is that a network A and a network B are set, the IP address range of the network A is 192.168.1.1-192.168.1.254, and the subnet mask is 255.255.255.255.0; network B has an IP address range of "192.168.192.168.2.254" and a subnet mask of 255.255.255.0. in the absence of a router, TCP/IP communication between the two networks is not possible, and even if the two networks are connected to the same switch (or hub), the TCP/IP protocol determines that the hosts in the two networks are in different networks based on the subnet mask (255.255.2550). to achieve communication between the two networks, a gateway must be passed through. And therefore a dedicated IP encryption needs to be set.

Preferably, the setting of the basic functions of the call center comprises IVR automatic voice navigation, customers consult and purchase products, and the required destinations are automatically found through the IVR voice navigation provided by the call center software.

Preferably, the setting up of the basic functions of the call center includes automatic call allocation, the system supports the average allocation of telephone traffic according to the historical conditions of the number of times of connection and the length of the call time of the telephone operator in a period of time, the average telephone workload of the telephone operator is reached, and a plurality of different allocation modes are supported: the round robin, the most idle seat allocation and the least occupied seat allocation, the telephone number entering the system can be automatically allocated by the ACD system according to the preset rules.

Preferably, the setting of the basic functions of the call center comprises automatic reporting of the number of a job, and automatic reporting of the call center system after the call is connected with a seat: the xx customer service representative serves you.

Preferably, the setting of the basic functions of the call center comprises telephone queuing management, the call center software can provide an intelligent and efficient queue management function, can set a flexible queue ringing strategy and a priority order among queues, and has the functions of queue position notification, queue notification and the like.

Preferably, the setting of the basic functions of the call center comprises the incoming call screen popping, the incoming call system screen popping automatically, and the client information is recorded in real time, so that the client information can be recorded at any time and found at any time.

Preferably, the setting of the basic functions of the call center comprises call recording, the system provides an automatic recording function for incoming calls and outgoing calls, and can also back up, download, playback and the like for the call recording.

Preferably, the establishment of the basic functions of the call center comprises business acceptance, service request receiving, acceptance, return visit, special return visit and service satisfaction survey can be realized, service traces in the whole process are reserved, and a perfect statistical report is subjected to data analysis so as to meet the requirements of customers.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the following embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only a part of the embodiments of the present invention, and not all of the embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be derived by a person skilled in the art from the embodiments given herein without making any creative effort, shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention.

Step two: setting basic functions of the call center:

the basic functions of the call center are set to complete the establishment of a complete call system, wherein the establishment comprises the steps of;

firstly, IVR automatic voice navigation, customers consult and purchase products, and the required destinations are automatically found through the IVR voice navigation provided by call center software.

Secondly, automatic call allocation, the system supports the average allocation of telephone traffic according to the historical conditions of the number of times of connection and the length of the call time of the telephone operator in a period of time, achieves the average telephone workload of the telephone operator, and supports various allocation modes: the round robin, the most idle seat allocation and the least occupied seat allocation, the telephone number entering the system can be automatically allocated by the ACD system according to the preset rules.

Thirdly, automatically reporting the number of the employee, and automatically reporting by a call center system after the operator is connected with the telephone: the xx customer service representative serves you.

And fourthly, managing telephone queuing, wherein the call center software can provide an intelligent and efficient queue management function, can set a flexible queue ringing strategy and a priority sequence among queues, and has the functions of informing queue positions, notifying queues and the like.

And fifthly, popping a screen for incoming calls, automatically popping the screen for an incoming call system, recording the client information in real time, and enabling the client information to be recorded at any time and found at any time.

Sixth, conversation recording, the system provides automatic recording function to incoming call and outgoing call, can also backup, download and playback etc. to the call recording, and this function effectively helps the sales force to analyze oneself and customer's dialogue condition, in time discovers the problem and seeks the team solution, promotes the communication ability of oneself fast.

And seventhly, including business acceptance, service request receiving, acceptance, return visit, special return visit and service satisfaction survey can be realized, service traces in the whole process are reserved, and a perfect statistical form performs data analysis so as to meet the requirements of customers.

Step three: and (3) testing:

after the configuration is completed, the mobile phone dials an incoming number of a first robot, namely a number of a corresponding card on a gateway, then the calling number is converted into a manual number or the calling number is converted into the manual number without being identified twice, the calling number is directly converted into an account number corresponding to a second server, conversation with the corresponding robot can be realized, the acceptance criteria of gateway telephone and IP butt joint are basically the same, the specific operation is that a network A and a network B are set, the IP address range of the network A is 192.168.1.1-192.168.1.254, and the subnet mask is 255.255.255.255.0; network B has an IP address range of "192.168.192.168.2.254" and a subnet mask of 255.255.255.0. in the absence of a router, TCP/IP communication between the two networks is not possible, and even if the two networks are connected to the same switch (or hub), the TCP/IP protocol determines that the hosts in the two networks are in different networks based on the subnet mask (255.255.2550). to achieve communication between the two networks, a gateway must be passed through. And therefore a dedicated IP encryption needs to be set.

Combine example 1, example 2 and example 2: when the artificial intelligence is switched into the artificial intelligence through the steps, accurate information interaction can be realized, and the artificial intelligence automatically matches and automatically enters the next-stage artificial intelligence without manual operation.

Finally, it should be noted that: although the present invention has been described in detail with reference to the foregoing embodiments, it will be apparent to those skilled in the art that modifications may be made to the embodiments or portions thereof without departing from the spirit and scope of the invention.
